name: Gen1BillsBox
description: Replaces Bill's PC with a box you can see: the party down the left, the open box as a 5x4 grid on the right, and a cursor that picks a POKeMON up and puts it down. Drawn in the Game Boy's own font, four shades and line art, with the party menu's own icons in every slot -- so a menu-icon mod shows up here too. The PC's storage rows are renamed BILL'S BOX and SOMEONE'S BOX.
